verdict.rationale: Featurebase documents a Reports API that exposes the same analytics engine behind the dashboard's Reports section, so a PM can retrieve analytics programmatically or view them in-app. The evidence is a single line, though, and does not show which metrics are available or whether they cover adoption across the workspace (as opposed to feedback or support activity). Missing for 10: documented metric coverage for adoption/usage, workspace-level breakdowns, endpoint details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
